edits.before: From 3-6 Karma leans on RQ poke and shield-movespeed to peel, and a well-timed empowered shield can absorb Alistar's knockup burst, making these levels a coinflip of execution (Skill). But Alistar's own R flips extended trades hard: once he pops Unbreakable Will he shrugs off her burst and can W-Q all-in through her defenses.

His durability and reliable knockups let him dictate the all-in, and Karma's shields delay but don't deny his commitment, keeping the extended teamfight in his favor.
